notes.title: version 2.4.0
notes.content:
After way too much time I can finally announce a large update covering various fields, including graphics, sounds and performance. A rewrite and extension of half the codebase now allows for easier and more frequent updates, with some cool new stuff planed in subsequent versions.

The noteworthy changes:
[list]
[*] Overhauled the recipe book
[*] Reworked portals
[*] Step sounds
[*] Added 25 additional languages
[*] More digging and block break sounds
[*] Reworked buffs
[*] Items now burn in fire
[*] Material with effects are now animated in inventory too
[*] Added fps slider
[*] Improved buckets + sounds
[*] Improved a few paintings
[*] Added some edges to block items
[*] Improved GUI visuals
[*] You can now harvest plants by right-clicking
[*] Added better rain renderer
[*] Improved item pickup
[*] Improved fog
[*] Added tooltips to arrows and bullets
[*] Torches get destroyed in water
[*] Reworked recipes for the ring, bow and arrows
[*] Tin arrows
[*] Added ash as fertilizer
[*] Safe
[*] Leave blocks
[*] Basalt, slate and pebble
[*] Yellow colored blocks
[*] And probably a lot of smaller improvements I forgot about
[/list]

The more technical stuff:
[list]
[*] Rewrote and cleaned up major parts of the code
[*] Improved render scheduler and light engine performance
[*] Improved zoom especially on non-full HD screens
[*] New font engine and support for most glyphs
[*] Overhauled foliage system
[*] Decreased server latency and improved sync performance
[*] Improved collision engine and overall entity performance
[/list]

I would also like to invite you to our Discord, as it's easier to chat and discuss there: https://discord.gg/fe5Tdug

notes.title: version 2.3.2
notes.content:
Previously, an account to play multiplayer was required. That made verification of the user possible. However, to make multiplayer easier and to remove the dependence on a central verification server, accounts have been removed.

Existing players should not experience a change, new and guest player will be prompted to enter a character name.

Joining a friend works as usual.

Rain and snow animations have been improved and the spam of rain particle in the event of a lag has been fixed too.

notes.title: version 2.3.1
notes.content:
Today someone had a crash with paintings. It's fixed now.
I received generic errors on Intel GPUs, at least some of them are fixed now too.
A few minor bugs have been removed.
If you encounter a bug or crash and you know what causes them, please tell me!

notes.title: version 2.3.0 - sound overhaul and new renderer
notes.content:
Since development of the final major update takes longer as expected we prepared a partial update of the content already finished.
This updates tackles the horrible sound design and replaced every entities sound with fancy and unique samples.
We also detected driver and performance issues on the Intel 620 and 520 GPUs.  With a brand new render engine we eliminated most lag spikes and increased the performance significantly.
In respect to player feedback we increased the gravity of the player, making the player less bouncy and increasing the need of ladders. airships, stairs, ...

[list]
[*] new render engine
[*] smoother chunk lightener with visible generation but decreased lags
[*] added sounds to all entities
[*] fixed music not playing
[*] increased player gravity
[*] fixed stairs not connecting
[*] improved Dinomite
[*] improved Ghost
[*] added a radio
[*] decreased wood drops from trees
[*] added cave echo and under water muffle effects
[*] added cave sounds and dripping sounds
[*] fixed random multiplayer crashes
[*] added stone and marble pillars
[*] fixed spawning related errors
[*] fixed Lil' Bomb
[*] increased leaves density and decreased CPU usage
[*] dark spirits now explode
[*] added texture for the horn stick
[*] properly added bloom/glare effects to certain objects
[*] fixed digging animation shared between players
[*] increase big airship health
[*] translated and extended tutorial
[*] fixed crash when assigning delete key to control
[/list]

notes.title: version 2.2.0 - arrows, explosives, better sounds and more
notes.content:
[h1]version 2.2.0 is a major update focusing on general content and improvements[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33720690/b82e67ecad42b542f49febdecbbc8b8d122b8cd4.png[/img]

[h1]what's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*]added crouching, decreasing your height to get into smaller tunnels (default: left control key)
[*]bows now require arrows
[*]all firearms now require bullets
[*]added iron, steel, slime and glarestone bullets
[*]added iron, steel, slime and glarestone arrows
[*]added ice on lakes
[*]improved mining sounds
[*]added difficulty (peace (no enemies), normal and hard (drop 1/3 of your inventory))
[*]added lil' bomb, an annoying running bomb, dropping gunpowder
[*]added gunpowder, grenades and a grenade launcher
[*]liquids will now react
[*]added obsidian
[*]added the spawn, it allows you to set the world spawn
[*]added builder villager, selling blocks
[*]added muffins
[/list]

[h1]biomes[/h1]
[list]
[*]planet systems overhaul, each system has its own "theme"
[*]added 2 lava biomes
[*]added hot lava stone
[*]added lava gem, usable as a tool modifier to apply fire damage (dropped by hot lava stone)
[*]added flarewood tree (including sapling, wood, planks and wooden wall)
[/list]

[h1]performance[/h1]
[list]
[*]switched to TGA image format for less loading time
[*]re-added resource recycling for faster chunk loading
[*]dynamic radius for chunk loading
[/list]

[h1]and some smaller tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed enemy spawning too early, some enemies, including Orks, now spawn in higher systems.
[*]defeating the void golem now unlocks the second planet ring, the executioner the third
[*]fixed fullscreen-toggle error
[*]decreased health of ghost
[*]removed ores from map (made no sense)
[*]fixed crashes on unicode pathes (sorry to those affected by this bug!)
[*]fixed typos and smaller bugs
[*]dark spirits (and the dark spirit boss) now drops gunpowder
[*]moved mithril ore to system 2
[*]moved glarestone ore to system 3
[*]crystal golems spawn in system 3
[*]skeleton guards spawn in system 4
[*]increase shield modifier cooldown to 15 (from 5)
[/list]

[h1]what's next?[/h1]
[list]
[*]main quest expansion to unlock system 4
[*]another sounds overhaul
[*]custom planets - create and enter custom, optional private worlds, if you ever need more space or resources!
[*]signs - displays text or items, never forget which chest contains what again!
[*]and some community requested features
[/list]
